grid.note: Even columns sit half a hex LOWER (e.g. 1621 label 82 px below 1721 and 86 px above 1522). Fitted on 8 hex labels (anchors.json) plus 27 printed hex corners (vertices.json; key "HHHH:k", k=0 right corner, 1 bottom-right, 2 bottom-left, 3 left, 4 top-left, 5 top-right), sigma 3. Corner residuals <= 3.0 px; the max (6.5 px) is the label centres of 1522/1523 sitting ~5-6 px left of the hex centre line. The label centre sits 0.37 hex above the hex centre on this map (grid.py LABEL_DY is -0.32 from Salerno), so label-only fits should use -0.37. italygrid.py patches grid.grid_xy for the Italy parity at import time (grid.py itself is unchanged). Hex size here ~168 px flat to flat.

extent.mapEdgesVisible: West and south edges of the map sheet (photo left edge x~15 px and bottom y~2505 px, wood table beyond): this is the sheet corner, all non-playable sea with no hex grid. extent.note: Only 8 playable hexes have their centre in this photo. Column 17 rows 14-19 carry no hex lines (non-playable sea); along the right edge the left halves of the column-18 hexes 1814-1819 are outlined but their centres are off the photo (S photo). 1522.note: Mostly sea (~80%). Land is a strip of the Cuma / Lago Fusaro coast with a jagged shoreline in the lower (south-east) part of the hex, pale (clear) colour, no symbols. Outlined on all six sides, so it is a playable hex; recorded as clear because it is not all-sea.

1523.label: Bacoli
1523.note: Cape Miseno / Bacoli peninsula along the east side of the hex, the rest (~60%) sea. Of the land, about 55-60% is pale (clear) and 40-45% olive hill shading (one blob in the upper-right part of the land), so clear only narrowly; check. Port symbol (anchor in a white circle, no separate town circle) in the east of the hex just inside the 1523/1622 side; the name "Bacoli" is printed in the sea of 1623 to its lower right. A minor road from 1622 ends at the port. "Cape Miseno" is printed in the sea below the hex (in non-playable 1524).

1621.note: Coastline runs diagonally across the hex from its top-right corner to the bottom side; west/north-west half sea, east/south-east half pale clear land (with a small headland near the lower-left side). No symbols, no shading.

1622.note: Land in the north and west parts, Pozzuoli bay (sea) in the south-east ~40%. About two thirds of the land is olive hill shading (a ridge curving from the top centre to the lower left); rest pale clear. Hex label "1622" mostly hidden under the shading. Minor road enters across the 1622/1722 side near its north end, turns west then south and leaves across the 1523/1622 side to the Bacoli port. Part of the word "Pozzuoli" (the port in 1723) is printed in the bay at the lower right of this hex.

1720.note: West ~35% sea; the land is covered by the marsh pattern (dashes and grass tufts) except a thin pale strip along the bottom side. Lago di Patria area: dark grey shapes (the same dark grey used for the off-map islands Procida and Nisida, i.e. land outside the playable hexes) lie just north of the top side, in non-playable 1719; the lake itself is in 1819 (S photo). A paper fold runs north-south through the east part of the hex. Right corner just outside the photo.

1721.note: All land, pale clear. The coastline runs right along the 1620/1721 side (hex line and coast drawn side by side). A minor road (double dashed) starts inside the hex, west of centre (dead end, no continuation in any direction) and runs south across the 1721/1722 side. Paper fold through the east part.

1722.note: About two thirds covered by olive hill shading (centre and east); pale clear in the north-west. Label reads "722" (the "1" is under the road). Road junction in the south-west part: minor road from 1721 (north side), minor road west across the 1622/1722 side, minor road south across the 1722/1723 side. No mountain shading (the shading matches the olive hill colour of the Campi Flegrei hexes in the S photo).

1723.label: Pozzuoli
1723.note: Pozzuoli bay (sea) in the west/south-west ~45%; the land is mostly olive hill shading (~3/4) with a pale coastal strip. Port symbol (anchor in a white circle, no separate town circle) just below the hex label; the name "Pozzuoli" is printed to its west across the 1622/1723 boundary. Minor roads from the port: north across 1722/1723, north-east across 1723/1822, south-east across 1723/1823 (towards Bagnoli). East part in shadow beyond the paper fold; right corner just outside the photo.

1524.note: Sea. The automatic test flagged 1524/1525 because the "Allied Support Markers" heading lies there; no hex line by eye.

1620.note: Sea. The 1620/1721 side scores low only because the coastline is drawn right beside the hex line; by eye it is drawn.

1623.note: All sea (Pozzuoli bay south of 1622); the name "Bacoli" is printed here. Its three southern sides carry no hex line.

1719.note: Sea plus dark grey (non-playable land) shapes of the Lago di Patria outlet.

1724.note: I. di Nisida (dark grey islet with a causeway line to the mainland in 1823/1824) lies in this hex; non-playable.

1622-1722.note: Crosses about a quarter of the way down from the 1621/1622/1722 corner.

1523-1622.note: Road to the Bacoli port; crosses a little below the middle of the side.

1721-1722.note: Crosses about 30% from the west end.

1722-1723.note: Crosses a little west of the middle.

1723-1822.note: Pozzuoli to the north-east; crosses about 20% along from the 1722/1723/1822 corner. 1822 centre is off this photo: confirm in the S photo.

1723-1823.note: Pozzuoli to Bagnoli; crosses near the middle. 1823 centre is off this photo: confirm in the S photo.

turnRecordTrack.layout: 32 boxes in six rows (turns 1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16-20, 21-25, 26-32). Each box: turn number in red (top left), dates in black bold italic (top right), event text in the middle, replacement icons along the bottom (Allied at bottom left, stacked when two; German at bottom right, stacked when two with the "Ge" label beside the lower icon only), and the VP benchmark in a yellow strip under the box.

covered.note: No playable hex is covered. The Weather Table (lower part), the Turn Record Track with its legend, and the Allied Support Markers box are printed on the non-playable sea of the Gulf of Gaeta/Naples, where no hex grid is drawn. Rough extrapolation of the grid (unreliable this far from the anchors): the Turn Record Track spans about columns 6-16, rows 16-27; the visible part of the Weather Table about columns 6-12, rows 13-15; the Allied Support Markers box about columns 13-16, rows 24-25.

uncertain: 1523 terrain: clear only narrowly over hill (about 55-60% of the land is pale); check against another photo.
1522 is ~80% sea but has a strip of land, so recorded as clear, not sea.

Pozzuoli (1723) and Bacoli (1523) are drawn with the port symbol only (anchor in a white circle) and a name, no town circle: recorded as port + label. Whether a named port counts as a town (e.g. for the Determined Defense table) is a rules call.
Roads 1723-1822 and 1723-1823: the neighbour hexes are centred off this photo; confirm in the S photo.
The minor road in 1721 ends inside the hex (dead end); the S photo cannot see this spot.

The olive shading in 1622/1722/1723 is read as hill shading, not mountain: it has the same tone ratio to clear (about 0.5) as the Campi Flegrei hill hexes in the S photo, and no hexside is covered by the much darker mountain shading. So no mountain hexsides here.
notes: Playable hexes were identified from the printed hex lines: a playable hex has all six sides drawn; a non-playable sea hex has lines only where it borders a playable hex (edge_scores.json, edges.py). Non-playable land (islands, the Lago di Patria spit in 1719) is drawn dark grey.

Terrain: colour fractions (samples.json) checked by eye at 3x on each hex (zoom/hex_*.png). In this warm-lit photo clear terrain looks beige and hill shading olive-brown; the S photo shows the same hexes (1720-1723 at its left edge) in neutral colours: 1720 marsh, 1721 clear, 1722 hill.
No rivers, lakes, mountain hexsides, passes, VP circles, airfields, towns, cities, landmarks or peaks in the transcribed hexes.
A paper fold runs north-south at x~1875 px through column 17 (bright line, shadow on its east side).

Scripts: italygrid.py (Italy parity + corner anchors), calib.py, ov.py, overlay.py, edges.py, sample.py, labels.py, vcrop.py, hexcrops.py, icons.py, build_json.py.
